# District 1 Elections

States of Jersey elections held in District 1 — St Mary, St Ouen & St Peter — since 2022:

- **[Deputies Elections](https://flow.je/elections/district-1#deputies)**

**[St Mary Elections](https://flow.je/elections/st-mary)**

**[St Ouen Elections](https://flow.je/elections/st-ouen)**

## Deputies Elections

The 2022 elections are the first to utilise the new electoral districts.

* * *

### 2022 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 22nd June 2022.

**[Kristina Moore](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kristina-moore), [Lucy Stephenson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lucy-stephenson), [Ian Gorst](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-gorst) and [Lyndon Farnham](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndon-farnham) were elected as Deputies of District 1 in 2022.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Kristina Moore](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kristina-moore)** | Better Way | 2,730 | 73.8% |
| 2 | **[Lucy Stephenson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lucy-stephenson)** | Better Way | 2,239 | 60.5% |
| 3 | **[Ian Gorst](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-gorst)** |  | 2,208 | 59.7% |
| 4 | **[Lyndon Farnham](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndon-farnham)** |  | 1,101 | 29.8% |
| 5 | [David Benn](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-benn) | Advance Jersey | 1,053 | 28.5% |
| 6 | [Helen Evans](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/helen-evans) | Reform Jersey | 1,050 | 28.4% |
| 7 | [Rowland Huelin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rowland-huelin) | Jersey Alliance | 1,025 | 27.7% |

3,700 ballots (inc. 15 spoilt papers)

7,573 registered voters

48.9% turnout

* * *

### 2026 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 7th June 2026.

- [David Benn](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-benn) : Previous Candidate \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/21/call-for-action-on-spending-as-candidate-stands-again-after-2022-near-miss/)\]
- [Arlene Maltman](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/arlene-maltman) : New Candidate \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/14/former-surfing-champ-to-ride-the-election-wave/)\]
- [Lucy Stephenson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lucy-stephenson) : Current Deputy of District 1 \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/17/deputy-seeks-second-term-representing-three-parish-district/)\]
